subtitle: Lesson 5 · Flow Logic & Data

eyebrow: Data pills: reference what already exists
code:
Trigger: Incident Created
  -> exposes pills: Short Description, Priority, Caller...

Step 3: Notify action
  message body: [Short Description pill] is now assigned

At runtime: pill is swapped for the real record value
caption: Pills come from the trigger or a prior step's output — never typed by hand.

eyebrow: Flow variables: define it yourself, up front
code:
Flow Variables panel:
  approval_threshold  (Integer)  default: 1000

Available anywhere in the flow, same drag-and-drop
as a data pill -- but it has no upstream record source.
caption: A flow variable has no trigger or step behind it; you define it directly.

steps.label: Already exists upstream?
steps.sub: trigger record field or a prior step's output -- use a data pill

steps.label: No natural source?
steps.sub: a constant, a calculated value, something you define -- use a flow variable

steps.label: Reused across steps?
steps.sub: define once as a flow variable instead of repeating a value

steps.label: Both in one flow
steps.sub: most real flows combine pills for record data and variables for constants

code:
Flow variable:  approval_threshold = 1000
Data pill:      [Requested Item price] (from Look Up Record)

If/Else condition (next lesson):
  [price pill] > [approval_threshold variable] -> extra approval
caption: One value defined by the flow, one pulled from the record -- same drag-and-drop reference.
